summary: Frontend regression + bug-fix verification for the Vacancy Poster Share feature. Verified: (1) new pill-style share button on vacancy cards with 'पोस्टर'/'POSTER' label on emerald gradient, (2) ShareModal input renders slate text (rgb(15,23,42)) on white bg — no dark-theme inheritance, (3) long shop name 'GRAMIN SUVIDHA KENDRA' fits header without cropping, (4) long job title 'Project Associate I, Senior Project Associate – 4 Posts' auto-scaled and wraps to 2 lines without overflow, (5) empty phone → no empty green pill in header (only banner/footer green icons remain), (6) 3-char 'abc' phone → no pill (length>=4 gate works), (7) valid '+91 81687 62016' → pill renders with visible text, (8) /vacancies/:id has matching emerald-gradient 'पोस्टर शेयर' pill + 'लिंक' chip button. Backend regression via curl: /api/enquiry (with correct schema full_name/mobile/email/service/message) = 200, /api/solar/apply = 410, /vacancies/stats total=430, online=247, offline=88, other=95, sum=430 ✓.

issues: TOTAL POSTS shows '—' (em-dash) when structured.total_posts is missing on the vacancy — cosmetic, not part of current bugfix scope. Poster.toPosterVacancy could fall back to parsing post_name (e.g., '4 Posts') to fill this.

critical_code_review_comments: Poster.jsx: adaptive fontSize logic is clean but uses inline ternaries — extract helper `pickFontSize(text, thresholds)` if more variants are added.
ShareModal.jsx: overlay onClick={onClose} + card stopPropagation is correct; consider adding aria-modal='true' and role='dialog' for a11y.
toPosterVacancy in Vacancies.jsx duplicated in VacancyDetail.jsx (per repo pattern) — move to a shared util to avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: None. Used real vacancy id 6a79f2a973b3a36f00e80aa5 (55-char post_name) for long-title verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 reported bugs are visually verified fixed. Share button now clearly labeled 'पोस्टर'. Screenshots saved at /app/test_reports/modal_typed.png and /app/test_reports/poster_empty_phone.png. Enquiry API requires schema: full_name/mobile/email/service/message (not name/phone).
rca of the issue: Bug1 (text overflow): pre-fix used single hard-coded font size in Poster header/title/org — fixed via length-based adaptive fontSize with wordBreak+overflowWrap. Bug2 (empty green pill): pre-fix only checked truthiness of `contact` — fixed to `contact.trim().length >= 4`. Bug3 (invisible input text): pre-fix relied on default color, OS/browser dark-theme autofill overrode it — fixed by explicit `color:'#0f172a'` + `background:'#ffffff'` on input styles and card.
